review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity/base commit, precise writable owner scopes, task keys, and evidence stages match the original PRD. The current HTTPError owner supports adding a live getter without changing the writable response contract or existing error metadata. Runtime regression coverage and compile-time rejection of status assignment are correctly separated: test-d is included by tsconfig.test.json, while AVA/tsx execution is not treated as type checking. The build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated artifacts rather than separately maintained writable owners. TASK-VERIFY must remain independent, depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, and cover all required acceptance criteria alongside implementation coverage. Both allowed assignees have the relevant supplied active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change, domain.state, and integration.consumer; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Eligibility does not rely on Persona or pending-only claims. A separate configured reviewer supports the stated earlier review prerequisite. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C scenario is present in this case's frozen specification, so the ready expectation with no blockers is consistent. Release fingerprints match between Gold and preview; the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. The isolation record states that this Gold precedes every candidate on the bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval reviews supplied evidence only: it does not attest human approval, task dispatch, successful execution, or independently recomputed Service digests.
